name: HF Agent
author: 0xSero
description: Open any installed coding agent on a model served by Hugging Face Inference Providers, from one button on the bar. Give it your Hugging Face token once, pick a model from the router's list, pick a harness, Launch. No containers, no local weights, no GPU, no config file of yours touched; the token lives in one 0600 file and never enters a process argument.

barWidget.description: Pick a Hugging Face Inference Providers model and a coding agent; Launch opens the agent on it.
